source: Captured from the user-authorized Gemini test conversation; only its three conversation-container subtrees are retained.
capture: Chrome DevTools DOM clones with the inspected chat-history-scroll-container and infinite-scroller parent chain.
sanitization: Page head, account, sidebar and composer were never captured. Scripts, styles, remote media, decorative SVGs, buttons and comments were removed. Attribute allowlist retains only classes, direction, roles, non-identifying ARIA state and data-path-to-node; all IDs, URLs, event handlers, Angular bindings and tracking metadata were removed.
layout: Offline CSS models observed overflow-y:scroll, flex-direction:column and turn-content-visibility content-visibility:auto with contain-intrinsic-size:auto 500px. After styles load, the test scrolls to the bottom and models a content mutation to reparse while earlier headings are skipped.
reproduction: The three first-response H3 elements had empty innerText while their textContent still contained complete headings; the sidebar rendered three empty rows.
limitation: Static DOM capture and reduced offline layout. Dynamic streaming and node replacement are modeled by tests; generated images and original styles are omitted. The separate live reproduction conversation is not stored.
